_doc: Where each managing company publishes its quarterly single-asset lists (רשימת נכסים ברמת הנכס הבודד, CMA circular 2015-9-14, uniform Excel). Files follow the CMA name <company id>_<product>_p_<Q><YY>.xlsx; product: gm = קופות גמל (incl. השתלמות, גמל להשקעה), pn = קרנות פנסיה, ca = מבטיח תשואה, in = ביטוח משתתף ברווחים. 'pages' are read by probe.py (kind html: links in the page; kind wix: Wix dataset items embedded in the page). 'patterns' are direct file URLs used only for quarters a page no longer lists. status: ok | partial | blocked | js_only | not_found. Probed 23.10.26 with the fox User-Agent, one request every 2 s; robots.txt honoured on every host.

phoenix.name: הפניקס
phoenix.note: BLOCKED 23.10.26: after a few requests digital-content.fnx.co.il answered with a Radware 'Verifying your browser' page; stopped for the site. Before that: pension only. www.fnx.co.il is a client-rendered app behind an AWS WAF challenge script, so its asset-list pages carry no links; the legacy server digital-content.fnx.co.il still serves the יסוד page, whose files are the consolidated pension list. Gemel and managers' insurance lists not reachable without running the site's scripts.

migdal.name: מגדל
migdal.note: managers' insurance participating portfolio (in) only: its items are embedded in the Wix page. The מקפת pension and gemel lists on /regulations/asset-list are loaded by the browser from the Wix data API (session token), so they are not fetched.

menora.name: מנורה מבטחים
menora.note: first page load listed the files (cdn.menoramivt.co.il, 512245812_*_p_QQYY.xlsx); the next requests got a Radware captcha page (23.10.26). Stopped for the whole site, CDN included.
